title: Kabse Crunchy Vegan Snack
description: This Argentinian snack combines fermented kabse spice with crunchy textures and is vegan-friendly, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.

ingredients.name: Coconut Oil or Vegan Butter
ingredients.notes: For coating the kabbelella for a crunchy exterior

instructions: Place the Kabbelella in a bowl of water to ferment as per recipe instructions (usually involves soaking overnight).
Drain and dry the Kabbelella, then gently coat with coconut oil or vegan butter.
In a pan, heat coconut oil or vegan butter until it starts smoking. Add the coated kabbelella pieces for about 1-2 minutes on each side until golden brown and crunchy.
Meanwhile, if using, mix Vegan Cream Cheese with the water to create a spreadable consistency.
Serve the crispy kabbelella slices alongside the cream cheese or as a standalone snack. Can be refrigerated up to one day after preparation.
